title: Diagnosing Drain Ventilation Failures
description: When fixtures drain sluggishly or emit foul sewer odors despite a clear pipe interior, the root cause is often inadequate drain ventilation. Vent systems introduce air into the drainage network, equalizing pressure so wastewater can flow smoothly without pulling trap seals dry. Without proper venting, siphoning occurs, breaking the water barrier that blocks sewer gases. Professional troubleshooting involves checking roof terminations for obstructions like leaves or ice, and inspecting branch lines for missing or incorrectly placed vents. Understanding how air pressure interacts with flowing water is essential for diagnosing stubborn drainage issues that chemical cleaners cannot fix.
